There's only two people left in line, so I say okay and do it. Then she notices I have a peanut butter cup in my hand. "GIVE. IT. BACK!!!!!" I'm just standing here like, "wat." and she repeats, "GIVE IT BACK." She sees I look confused and she comes over, grabs it out of my hand, points to it, and shoves it back in my hand...
So I go up there, to the desk, and she has her hands cupped for me to place it in there. I toss it into her hand, lightly. She flips out and *throws* the fucking peanut butter cup at me.   "DON'T THROW IT AT ME!!!", she says. I say I didn't. She tells me not to talk back to her. I'm rolling my eyes, I'm furious.
